_why: ADR-707 Phase 8 (#783, CLOSED) scoped 'Per-row span construction at PartitionReceiver consumes the column.' Three of four parts shipped — the _traceparent system column (COL_TRACEPARENT), the traceparent_at(row_idx) accessor, the producer (kafka/reader.rs:1873 materialises per row), and the DLQ consumer (partition_receiver.rs:1135). Span construction did NOT: partition_receiver.rs:1023 still reads record.headers_at(0) and calls extract_trace_context_if_sampled once per RECORD. Post-Phase-5c a StreamRecord is a multi-row partition-coalesced batch of N Kafka messages each with its own upstream traceparent, so every row inherits row 0's trace context and one sampling decision covers the whole batch — the exact loss the column was added to prevent. The column is populated correctly and never read for spans. THIS TASK IS READ-ONLY STAGE-1: the fix direction is pinned by #783 (per-row), but span CARDINALITY (N spans per record vs one span with per-row links) has real cost on the tracing hot path and is NOT decided. A worker must not choose it. Produce the analysis and stop.
